title: CC Color Correcting Tinted Serum, Hydrating Light Coverage Skin Tone Evener CC Cream
body_html: Dual Effect of Skin Care & Light Makeup This tinted CC serum combines skincare essence and sheer makeup base, moisturizes dry skin while evening uneven tone, perfect for lazy daily no-makeup glow look. Natural Color Correction & Sheer Coverage Effectively covers redness, dullness, minor blemishes and dark spots without heavy cakey texture, delivers translucent healthy glowing skin finish. 6 Inclusive Shades For Diverse Skin Tones From fair ivory to deep cocoa shades, covers light, medium and deep complexions, avoids grey or orange fake white cast, fits most global skin tones. Lightweight Breathable Non-Greasy Texture Watery silky texture absorbs quickly into skin, non-comedogenic, won’t clog pores or cause oil buildup, suitable for oily, dry and sensitive skin types. Multi-Scenario Daily Base Makeup Can be used as primer, tinted moisturizer, light foundation or post-sun repair brightening cream; ideal for commute, travel, gym and casual daily occasions.
